Pointer to a structure containing information about a specific GPIO device. This function initializes an InstancePtr object for a specific device specified by the contents of Config. This function can initialize multiple instance objects with the use of multiple calls giving different Config information on each call.

Device base address in the virtual memory address space. The caller is responsible for keeping the address mapping from EffectiveAddr to the device physical base address unchanged once this function is invoked. Unexpected errors may occur if the address mapping changes after this function is called. If address translation is not used, use Config->BaseAddress for this parameter, passing the physical address instead.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if the initialization is successful.

briefdescription.para: Sets output discretes to logic 1 for the specified GPIO channel.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XGpio instance to operate on.
GPIO channel (1 or 2) to operate on.
Set of bits that are set to 1 in the discrete data register. All other bits in the data register are unaffected.

simplesect.para:
The hardware must be built for dual channels if this function is used with any channel other than 1. If it is not, this function asserts.
This API can only be used if the GPIO_IO ports in the IP are used for connecting to the external output ports.

simplesect.para:

This API can only be used if the GPIO_IO ports in the IP are used for connecting to the external output ports.

briefdescription.para: Runs a self-test on the driver and device.

detaileddescription.para: This function performs a minimal test in which the data register is read. It only does a read without any kind of test. The hardware may be parameterized as input only, and the state of the input is unknown.
All other hardware features of the device are not guaranteed to be in the hardware since they are parameterizable.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XGpio instance to operate on. This parameter must be initialized with XGpio_Initialize().

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS always. If the GPIO device is not present in the hardware a bus error is generated. Other indicators of a bus error, such as registers in bridges or buses, may be necessary to determine if this function caused a bus error.

briefdescription.para: Enables the interrupt output signal.

detaileddescription.para: Interrupts enabled through XGpio_InterruptEnable() are not passed through until the global enable bit is set by this function. This function is designed to allow all interrupts (both channels) to be enabled easily for exiting a critical section. This function asserts if the hardware device has not been built with interrupt capabilities.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XGpio instance to operate on.

briefdescription.para: Disables the interrupt output signal.

detaileddescription.para: Interrupts enabled through XGpio_InterruptEnable() are no longer passed through until the global enable bit is set by XGpio_InterruptGlobalEnable(). This function is designed to allow all interrupts (both channels) to be disabled easily for entering a critical section. This function asserts if the hardware device has not been built with interrupt capabilities.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XGpio instance to operate on.

briefdescription.para: Enables interrupts for the specified channels.

detaileddescription.para: Also call XGpio_InterruptGlobalEnable() to enable the global interrupt; otherwise, no interrupts occur. This function asserts if the hardware device has not been built with interrupt capabilities.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XGpio instance to operate on.
Mask to enable. Bit positions of 1 are enabled. This mask is a bitwise OR of XGPIO_IR* bits, which are contained in xgpio_l.h.

briefdescription.para: Disables interrupts for the specified channels.

detaileddescription.para: This function disables specific interrupts for each channel. This function asserts if the hardware device has not been built with interrupt capabilities.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XGpio instance to operate on.
Mask to disable. Bits set to 1 are disabled. This mask is a bitwise OR of XGPIO_IR* bits, which are contained in xgpio_l.h.

briefdescription.para: Clears pending interrupts with the provided mask.

detaileddescription.para: Call this function after the software has serviced the interrupts that are pending. This function asserts if the hardware device has not been built with interrupt capabilities.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XGpio instance to operate on.
Mask to clear pending interrupts. Bit positions of 1 are cleared. This mask is a bitwise OR of XGPIO_IR* bits, which are contained in xgpio_l.h.

briefdescription.para: Returns the interrupt enable mask.

detaileddescription.para: This function asserts if the hardware device has not been built with interrupt capabilities.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XGpio instance to operate on.

simplesect.para: A mask of bits made from XGPIO_IR* bits which are contained in xgpio_l.h.

briefdescription.para: Returns the status of interrupt signals.

detaileddescription.para: Any bit in the mask set to 1 indicates that the channel associated with the bit has asserted an interrupt condition. This function asserts if the hardware device has not been built with interrupt capabilities.
The interrupt status indicates the status of the device regardless of whether the interrupts from the devices have been enabled or not through XGpio_InterruptEnable().

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XGpio instance to operate on.

simplesect.para: Mask of bits made from XGPIO_IR* bits which are contained in xgpio_l.h.
